description:
Third phase of bl-7c23. Migrate the prompt path from ex/<ts>-<id> branches and exchanges/<id>/steps/ paths to the new shape.

=== Scope ===

1. Branch naming. src/prompt/dispatch.rs: drop the ex/<ts>-<id> generator; root conversation runs on main itself (no separate branch); subagent conversations (v0.4 onward) use hyphenated descent, but for v0.3 the dispatch path only handles the root case.
   - For the root case: instead of spawning ex/..., the lernie prompt path still spawns a working branch (because nothing commits directly to main except the initial scaffold), but the branch name is just <root-id> with no prefix. Wait — re-read ARCH §2.3: 'The root conversation runs on main.' So actually, the root conversation IS main. There is no separate branch for it. The first user message commits step records on main directly via the worktree at root/. Reconcile this with 'Nothing commits directly to main except the conversation-repo's initial snapshot. All subsequent data on main arrives via merge from a completed root-conversation dispatch — i.e., a user-message exchange.' These two statements conflict on the surface.
   - RESOLUTION FOR THIS BALL: root conversation runs on a per-exchange branch off main, hyphenated id only (no ex/ prefix), merged back to main on completion. The 'runs on main' phrasing in §2.3 paragraph 2 is shorthand; paragraph 3 ('Nothing commits directly to main except…') is the load-bearing one. Update ARCH §2.3 paragraph 2 wording for clarity as part of this ball if needed.
2. Worktree path: <conv-repo>/<branch-id>/ for non-main branches; root/ stays the primary checkout (which is main). dispatch.rs allocates the worktree at the new path.
3. Step path: src/prompt/step.rs — step_dir_rel becomes 'steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>'. Update all callers and asserts.
4. Goal/soul write at dispatch: src/prompt/dispatch.rs writes goal.md AND soul.md (from <conv-repo>/souls/<role>.md) to the worktree root, commits them as the dispatch commit. Drop .agent/goal.md.
5. src/prompt/tests/* — every fixture and assert that mentions ex/, .agent/, exchanges/, .lernie/worktrees/ flips to the new shape.

=== Constraints ===

- Test suite must be green on review. The 100% coverage gate enforces this.
- If Phase 2 was merged with a compat shim, this phase removes it.
- Do not attempt subagent-dispatch logic here (v0.4); only the root-conversation case matters for v0.3.

=== Out of scope ===

- Compactor path (Phase 5).
- Schema regen (Phase 6).
- Subagent dispatch (v0.4 / bl-683c follow-on).

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: Phase 3: branch naming + step path migration
